zh.title: 美妆生活方式内容
zh.summary: 美妆生活方式内容制作：围绕产品宣传组织拍摄。
zh.preview: 产品宣传需要与具体内容制作相连接。本案以美妆产品的生活方式内容为任务，Vivian Adventure 参与宣传内容与拍摄制作。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与产品宣传内容与拍摄制作，让传播主题与实际内容产出在同一项制作任务中衔接。
zh.context: 这是一项围绕美妆产品展开的生活方式内容项目。项目需求是制作与产品相关的人物内容，把产品宣传落实到拍摄任务。

narrativeSections.heading: 从产品宣传到内容制作
narrativeSections.text: 本案的工作重点是将美妆产品纳入生活方式内容。宣传内容与拍摄制作相互关联：产品是内容的主题，制作则承担将这一主题具体呈现的任务。

deliverables: 美妆产品生活方式影像
outcomes: 交付为围绕产品制作的生活方式内容，体现产品宣传内容的制作能力。

en.title: Beauty Lifestyle Content
en.summary: Beauty lifestyle content production, connecting product promotion with the shoot.
en.preview: Product promotion needs a practical content assignment. This project centred on lifestyle imagery for a beauty product, with Vivian Adventure involved in promotional content and production.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to product promotional content and photography, connecting the subject of the communication with the work of producing it.
en.context: This was a beauty product lifestyle content project. The assignment concerned talent-led product content, translating a promotional need into a photographic production task.

narrativeSections.heading: From product to content assignment
narrativeSections.text: The product was the subject of the lifestyle content. Promotional content and photography were related parts of the work: one established what the content concerned, while production gave it a tangible form.

outcomes: The output was product-centred lifestyle content, demonstrating production capability for product promotion.
